Contains must not consume unconsumed values or re-retain previously consumed values. The actual routed canonical sample must preserve/delete the cookie-backed value on the appropriate subsequent request.

A prepared benchmark lookup must invoke the actual ICollection.Contains slot (except the explicitly named untouched ContainsKey control), return the expected Boolean, and leave the prepared collection intact.
